title: Immutable Hall-map registry record (hallmap_registry_record_v1)
description: One record = one file <registry_dir>/records/<seq:06d>_<first 16 hex of the record's own sha256>.json, written once by abep_sim/hallmap_registry.py with an exclusive atomic create (os.link of a fully written, read-only temporary file) and never edited or deleted. Records form a hash chain: prev_record_sha256 is the sha256 of the previous record FILE's bytes (null for seq 1). A REGISTRATION binds a design Hall map and everything it depends on by sha256; a WITHDRAWAL retires an earlier REGISTRATION (e.g. its member eliminated by new evidence) without touching it. All file paths are repository-relative POSIX paths. DRAFT for owner review.
x-milestones: A: not needed. B/C: precondition for using any admitted-member design map as evidence (offline provenance re-verification, lane 15 open question). No admitted member exists (credible set empty, 2026-09-26), so no record can be created today.
x-verify_rules: every file in records/ matches ^\d{6}_[0-9a-f]{16}\.json$, seq runs 1..N without gaps, the name's hex prefix equals the sha256 of the file bytes, and prev_record_sha256 equals the previous record's sha256

REGISTRATION blocks map, raw_records, chemistry (unless built-in), geometry, magnetic_field, convergence_prereg, o4_dispositions, admission_decision: the named file exists and re-hashes to the recorded sha256 (raw_records also to sha256_canonical_jsonl, decompressed for .gz)

map: canonical sha256 of meta (json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')), the form of abep_sim.thermal_life._canonical_sha256) == map_meta_sha256; meta.schema == schema_version; meta.ensemble_member_id and meta.hallthruster_commit equal the record; meta.facility_ingestion is false; meta.provenance present with map_set.status FROZEN and numerics.convergence.verdict PASS; abep_sim.hallmap_registry.PROVENANCE_EQUALITIES hold (lane 35 schemas/hallmap/hallmap_provenance_v1.json)
geometry.file and magnetic_field.file never match the P5/ECHT evidence-file pattern of hallmap_provenance_v1.json; convergence_prereg is never a DRAFT

currency: hallthruster.commit == current hallthruster_bridge/PINNED.toml commit; the member passes abep_sim.hall_ensemble.require_admitted on the current ensemble (screening candidates and unknown ids refused), and its admission record's decision_file/decision_sha256 and o4_dispositions_file/o4_dispositions_sha256 (bridge-relative, prefixed with hallthruster_bridge/) equal admission_decision and o4_dispositions

ensemble_sha256_at_registration and pinned_toml_sha256_at_registration are provenance of the registration moment only (both files legitimately change: new members, reaction-set bumps); they are not re-hashed
a WITHDRAWAL names an earlier REGISTRATION not already withdrawn; its decision file re-hashes to its sha256

file.x-note: Vyovrinda's own design file; P5/ECHT evidence files are never design geometry or B(z) (same rule as hallmap_provenance_v1.json)

map_meta_sha256.description: canonical sha256 of the map's meta object; the key lane 15 (abep_sim/thermal_life.py admitted_hallmap provenance) looks records up by

sha256_canonical_jsonl.description: sha256 of the dataset content (decompressed for .gz); must equal meta.provenance.raw_records.sha256_canonical_jsonl

ensemble_member_id.description: an ADMITTED member (abep_sim.hall_ensemble.require_admitted); screening candidates sgb-screen-* are refused by that call, not by an id pattern (an admitted member keeps its screening id)

oneOf.description: project propellant config (e.g. an immutable snapshot of a hallthruster_bridge/propellants/*.toml); a mutable production TOML that is edited later makes the record fail integrity (intended)
built-in solver chemistry (e.g. 'builtin-Xe'), identified by the pinned solver commit
